name: ServiceNow MCP Server Console
description: Serves ServiceNow instance skills and APIs to external MCP clients such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot through governed, OAuth-secured MCP servers, for ServiceNow admins.

skills.name: Configure MCP Servers
skills.description: Creates MCP servers on a ServiceNow instance and chooses which AI skills and Scripted REST API tools each one exposes to clients.

skills.name: Cross-Instance MCP Client
skills.description: Calls MCP servers on another ServiceNow instance from AI applications, through the ServiceNow Model Context Protocol Client.
